subject: science
concept: Designing and conducting an investigation testing one of Newton's Laws or an energy transformation
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Planning and Carrying Out Investigations) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student designs and runs a simple investigation (e.g. varying mass and measuring acceleration) and records results
exercise.abstract: Student states a conclusion connecting their investigation's results to the relevant physics principle

assessment.mastery_threshold: conclusion is logically connected to the investigation's actual recorded results
misconception_flags: states a conclusion that contradicts or ignores their own recorded results

interest_binding: investigation topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
